---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 🎯 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why do you need it?

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📊 Use Case

Provide a specific use case or scenario where this feature would be helpful.

**Example:**
```
As a [role], I want to [action] so that [benefit].
```

## 🎨 Mockups/Examples

If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or code examples.

```sql
-- Example SQL if applicable
SELECT * FROM new_feature;
```

## 📝 Additional Context

Add any other context, links, or references about the feature request.

## 🏷️ Priority

- [ ] Critical - Blocking work
- [ ] High - Needed soon
- [ ] Medium - Would be nice to have
- [ ] Low - Future enhancement
